summary: Southern Company Gas filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, reporting that subsidiary Northern Illinois Gas Company (Nicor Gas) reached a Stipulation and Settlement with Illinois Commerce Commission Staff, the Illinois Attorney General, and consumer and industrial parties, potentially resolving the general base rate case filed January 9, 2026. Terms include an approximately $82 million annual base rate revenue increase, 9.48% return on equity, 50.00% equity ratio, target November 16, 2026 effective date, and dismissal of Nicor's pending appeal of the November 19, 2025 rate decision. The Illinois Commission is expected to rule by December 7, 2026. This is a routine utility ratemaking settlement, not a special situation.
